gloss: sleeping face; face of someone asleep

definitions.gloss: sleeping face; face of someone asleep
definitions.explanation: The face or facial expression of a person (or animal) while asleep. Often used affectionately.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寝顔|ねがお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: A child's sleeping face is adorable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寝顔|ねがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧⟦{見|み}つめた→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I quietly gazed at her sleeping face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寝顔|ねがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ぶ→吹き飛ぶ：11842_fukitobu⟧。
examples.english: Watching the baby's sleeping face makes the whole day's tiredness melt away.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to sleep) + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face). Refers to how someone looks while asleep, and carries a warm, affectionate nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝顔|ねがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at someone's sleeping face
- ⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧{寝顔|ねがお}: an adorable sleeping face
- {寝顔|ねがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a photo of a sleeping face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寝相|ねぞう}→寝相：08037_nezou⟧: sleeping posture — the position of the body while asleep, not the face.
